decision_cruda.rationale: E595-06 holds 260 t at 15.4 g/t (~129 oz) and its loader LH-01 is down until about 13:20 (range 12:20–14:20). Radio and CMMS agree, so the rules allow a move. Este trucks have spare capacity (72 t/h against 36 t/h inflow). LH-08 is on the cheap preparation heading (1.9 oz/h) and is 0.53 h away. It would muck about 30 t/h × 6.6 h ≈ 198 t ≈ 98 oz. The heading loses about 13.5 oz. Net is about 80 oz. I did not take LH-09 because it is on the critical-path heading (4 oz/h). LH-10 is not free until 11:00, and the repaired LH-01 can finish the remaining ~60 t.

Keep LH-08 on E595-06 (15.4 g/t, 242 t; LH-01 repair 12:20-14:20). LH-02 down at C512-04 (13 g/t, 296 t, repair 15:00-17:00). LH-10 finishes PM at 11:00, is free (no home cost), 0.34 h away, so it can load about 5.5 h at 25.4 t/h, roughly 140 t, about 58 oz. Central stockpile has room (298/450) and inflow falls without LH-02. I did not pull LH-09 (4.0 oz/h) or any producing loader.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
